commons.description: Military cemetery in Dąbrowa Tarnawacka, located on the main road Zamość - Tomaszów Lubelski, at the edge of the forest, leaving Tarnawatka-Tartak towards Tomaszów Lubelski. The cemetery was established after 1915. The soldiers who died during the First World War are buried in this cemetery. A mound was made on top of the graves, topped with a cross.
